pull:
**Pull request #4087 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #4087: Patch: the /stats win-rate bar reads the adjusted win rate

Closes #4084

## What changed

The Cards tab table on `/stats` now draws its little bar (`.stats-confidence-bar` / `.stats-confidence-fill`) in the **Adjusted** cell, sized by the adjusted win rate (`Math.round(adjustedWinRate * 100)%`) on the same 0–100% scale, reusing the existing `stats-winrate-cell` markup and CSS with no new styles. The Win rate cell keeps its percentage and its 95% range; rows below the sample floor or with a null/missing `adjustedWinRate` read exactly "—" in the Adjusted cell with no bar anywhere in the row. Grid, inspect panel, Sets/Players tabs, server and engine are untouched.

- [stats.tsx](apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx): table-row JSX only; bar + `R4084000` comment moved to the Adjusted cell behind a `typeof` guard, Win rate cell reduced to text + range.
- [stats.css](apps/web/src/routes/stats.css): one comment updated; no selector, property or value changed.
- [stats.test.tsx](apps/web/src/routes/stats.test.tsx): new `it("R4084000 …")` covering an enough-games card with differing raw/adjusted rates (bar at 53% in Adjusted, "60%" with no bar in Win rate, both ranges intact when on), a below-floor row, and a null-rate row (both "—", no bar).
- [R4084000.md](spec/rulings/R4084000.md) (new, amends R2777000), [4084.md](spec/pending/4084.md) (new §11 paragraph), [R2777000.md](spec/rulings/R2777000.md) (title + appended `**Amended.**` paragraph).

## How it was tested

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/stats.test.tsx`: 89 passed; the new test also confirmed individually via `-t "R4084000"` (1 passed, 88 skipped).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`: green.
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`: green.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: ok (2229 rulings, 5659 proofs).
- `cargo fmt --check`: clean (no Rust files touched).
- Grepped `stats-confidence` across `apps/web` and `e2e`: only `stats.tsx` and `stats.test.tsx` match, so no Cypress spec asserts the bar and none needed editing.

## Decisions

- Kept the 0–100% scale as the issue asks, even though adjusted rates cluster near 50%; a centered-on-50% rescale needs a person, recorded as Rejected in the ruling note.
- A null/missing rate with enough games renders bare "—" with no range line (previously a served range could have shown under "—"); the test pins this.

One environment note: `typecheck` ran out of memory at the default 2GB V8 heap on this machine, so it was rerun with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144` (about 6.7GB was free). No check was weakened.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 23.8 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 7s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 2s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |

</details>

---
Built overnight by @jgoetzmann-bot ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43959528613)); every run on it, step by step, is in its [journal](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/_bot-journal/4084.md). Comment `@jgoetzmann-bot <what to change>` or `/harness revise <notes>` to ask for a revision, or `/harness stop` to stop it.
```
